# JobDue

JobDue is a no-login browser app for solo contractors and home-service pros.
It helps users track jobs, unpaid balances, follow-ups, payment status, review requests, and local backup/export.

Canonical site: https://app.hi-craniai.workers.dev/
Product guide: https://app.hi-craniai.workers.dev/infographics.html
Purchase: https://buy.stripe.com/fZu3cu6WQebzeRxasv4c800
Support: hi.craniai@gmail.com

Current offer: $14.99 early-bird launch price through secure Stripe checkout. Regular listing price is $29.99.

Important product boundaries:
JobDue is not cloud sync, invoice sending, payment processing, dispatch software, team routing, QuickBooks integration, payroll software, or full accounting software.

Primary audience:
Solo handymen, contractors, cleaners, landscapers, painters, and small home-service operators who want a simple local job and payment tracker without monthly contractor software.
